theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (Xj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U 0) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U 0) (N : ℕ → Set (Eucl P)) (c : ℕ → Eucl P → ℤ) (Λ : ℝ), IsCompact (closure W) → WeaklyConvergesOn Xj X → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ N j, c j x ≠ 0) → (∀ j, (N j ∩ W).Finite) → (∀ j (S : Finset (Eucl P)), (↑S : Set (Eucl P)) ⊆ N j ∩ W → ∑ x ∈ S, |(c j x : ℝ)| ≤ Λ) → (∀ j (ω : TestFormOn U 0), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) 0) ⊆ W → Xj j ω = ∑ᶠ x ∈ N j, (c j x : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) 0) x ![]) → ∃ (D : Finset (Eucl P)) (a : Eucl P → ℤ), (↑D : Set (Eucl P)) ⊆ W ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U 0, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) 0) ⊆ W → X ω = ∑ x ∈ D, (a x : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) 0) x ![]
